blender.notes: Executes authored generators or staged static-model cleanup; does not synthesize arbitrary geometry from text.

meshy.notes: GLB and PBR; text preview and refine are separately approved tasks. Rigging targets humanoids.

higgsfield.notes: Uses documented Higgsfield CLI models; CLI/session not installed/configured during setup. Separate Cloud SDK APIs have different authentication.

comfyui.notes: Managed loopback SDXL and tiled Real-ESRGAN; material factory separately verifies periodic edges and authors selective maps. Core local nodes only.

tripo.notes: Official text/single/multi-image APIs identified; no standalone adapter implemented. Higgsfield's tripo_3d is a separate billed provider route.

external_image.notes: Extension slot, never selectable for execution until a concrete API and adapter are reviewed.

local_video.notes: No local video model installed; video is kept outside runtime assets.
